article.story: Charlotte (1-9) at Tulsa (6-4), Nov. 21 at 2 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Tulsa by 22.5. Against the spread: Tulsa 6-4, Charlotte 5-5. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Tulsa Offense Overall: 402.1 yards per game (48th in FBS) Passing: 234.0 yards per game (54th) Rushing: 168.1 yards per game (53rd) Scoring: 33.6 points per game (27th) Tulsa Defense Overall: 386.9 yards per game (96th in FBS) Passing: 208.6 yards per game (64th) Rushing: 178.3 yards per game (109th) Scoring: 22.6 points per game (53rd) Charlotte Offense Overall: 306.5 yards per game (128th in FBS) Passing: 197.4 yards per game (100th) Rushing: 109.1 yards per game (125th) Scoring: 19.3 points per game (125th) Charlotte Defense Overall: 434.9 yards per game (132nd in FBS) Passing: 251.4 yards per game (126th) Rushing: 183.5 yards per game (115th) Scoring: 36.2 points per game (136th) Tulsa is 121st in third down percentage, converting 33.1% of the time. Charlotte ranks 131st on defense, holding its opponents to 46.6%. Charlotte ranks 102nd in the FBS with a -4 turnover margin, compared to Tulsa's 6th-ranked +10 margin. Both teams avoid getting penalized. Tulsa is 19th in the FBS averaging 43.1 penalty yards per game, and Charlotte ranks 22nd with a 43.9-yard average. Charlotte is 121st in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 91.1% of trips. Tulsa's red zone offense ranks 47th, scoring on 87.2% of red zone opportunities. Tulsa is 124th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:45. Team leaders Tulsa Passing: Baylor Hayes, 1,990 yards, 16 TDs, 4 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Damari Alston, 573 yards on 128 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Oran Singleton, 775 yards on 63 catches, 7 TDs Charlotte Passing: Conner Harrell, 1,167 yards, 7 TDs, 4 INTs, 61.9 completion percentage Rushing: Henry Rutledge, 520 yards on 92 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Jaden Barnes, 599 yards on 60 catches, 3 TDs Last game Tulsa beat Florida Atlantic 38-21 on Nov. 14. Hayes threw for 309 yards on 21-of-32 attempts (65.6%) with two touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball six times for 20 yards. Alston had 92 rushing yards on 11 carries and one touchdown, adding three receptions for 28 yards. Javon Ross had six receptions for 163 yards. Charlotte lost 17-16 to East Carolina on Nov. 14. Harrell passed for 161 yards on 15-of-29 attempts (51.7%) with one touchdown and two interceptions. Rutledge carried the ball 15 times for 66 yards, adding two receptions for one yard. Derrick Eley had four receptions for 96 yards. Next game Tulsa plays at UTSA on Nov. 27. Charlotte hosts Navy on Nov. 28.
